data.one_liner: ANSI escape codes for styling strings in the terminal.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities and string extension methods to create colorful terminal output using ANSI escape codes. Allows chaining formatting properties such as colors, bold, italic, underline, and RGB values.
use_when: You need to output colored and styled text in command-line or terminal applications.
You want to strip ANSI styling from strings.
avoid_when: You are building a graphical user interface (GUI) or Flutter app where terminal text styling is not applicable.
strengths: Simple API with method chaining and string extension support.
Supports standard colors, bright variants, RGB, and background formatting.
weaknesses: Not documented for non-terminal UI applications.

alternatives.name: console
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative library for console and terminal manipulation utilities.
